description: Ken Lundy records this interview at John C. Hitt Library for the Knights Tales Project on September 11, 2026. He recalls working for Steelcase, whose headquarters was in Grand Rapids, Michigan, while his territory was New York City. On Labor Day 2001, Lundy and his wife had visited the New York City area to seek employment and find a place to stay; he recalls that this was his first time in the World Trade Center towers. On September 11, 2001, Lundy was back in Grand Rapids at Steelcase headquarters, where he watched events unfold and was unable to reach his wife, who was working for Social Security. He recalls meeting a friend in the World Trade Center shopping area during the earlier visit and seeing people who worked in the building. Lundy closes by remembering the victims and expressing hope for healing.

themes: Prior Visit to the World Trade Center
entities_and_facets.perspective: First-person recollection of watching events unfold at Steelcase headquarters in Grand Rapids and of a prior visit to the World Trade Center; the account does not place Lundy at the attack site on September 11.
